content.text: The cause is in `solution/util.py`: the name pattern ends in a lazy quantifier (`*?`), so `_NAME.match` only ever consumes one character. `{name}` then fails the `}` check. I'll make the quantifier greedy.

content.text: The visible suite now passes (3/3). The only file I changed is `solution/util.py`. Its `_NAME` regex was `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*?`, with a lazy quantifier. That made `render` match only the first character of each placeholder name, so `{name}` was rejected as malformed because the next character was not `}`. I changed the quantifier to greedy (`*`), which matches the full identifier. I did not touch `core.py`, `__init__.py`, or anything under `tests/`, and the public `render` API is unchanged.
